title: Verb to be: Negatives, Questions and Adjectives

vocabulary.meaning_en: the dot (.) at the end of a sentence

vocabulary.meaning_en: the sign (?) at the end of a question

fine_lines.title: tall vs long
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tall طويل لأعلى (من الأسفل إلى الأعلى) مثل الإنسان والمبنى والزرافة. long طويل امتدادًا على الأرض مثل الطريق والنهر والثعبان والقطار.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Tall is high from bottom to top: a person, a building, a giraffe. Long is from one end to the other: a road, a river, a snake, a train.

examples.sentence: The Nile is a long river.

fine_lines.title: old: not young vs not new
fine_lines.explanation_ar: old لها معنيان: عجوز (عكس young) وقديم (عكس new).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Old has two opposites: young (for people and animals) and new (for things).

examples.sentence: She is young. Her grandma is old.
My phone is new. My bag is old.

fine_lines.title: isn't vs aren't vs am not
fine_lines.explanation_ar: is not تُختصر isn't، و are not تُختصر aren't. أما am not فلا تُختصر بدمج not مع am؛ نقول I'm not.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Is not → isn't. Are not → aren't. Am not has no short form with not; we say I'm not.

fine_lines.title: big vs small
fine_lines.explanation_ar: big كبير الحجم و small صغير الحجم. للعمر نستخدم old و young.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Big and small are about size. For age, use old and young.

expressions.example: Are you hungry? Yes, I am.

expressions.phrase: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
expressions.example: Are you a vet? No, I'm not.

expressions.phrase: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
expressions.meaning_ar: نعم هو كذلك. / لا ليس كذلك.
expressions.example: Is it a book? Yes, it is.

expressions.phrase: Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
expressions.meaning_ar: نعم نحن كذلك. / لا لسنا كذلك.
expressions.example: Are you friends? Yes, we are.
Look! This is my pet. It's a cat.

grammar.title: Capital letters and end marks
grammar.explanation_ar: كل جملة تبدأ بحرف كبير (capital letter). ونُنهي الجملة العادية بنقطة (.) والسؤال بعلامة استفهام (?).
grammar.explanation_en: Every sentence starts with a capital letter. A normal sentence ends with a full stop (.), and a question ends with a question mark (?).

grammar.title: Adjectives after be and before nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة (adjective) تصف الاسم. تأتي بعد am/is/are: The elephant is big. أو قبل الاسم: a small bee. الصفات لا تُجمع: The mice are small (وليس smalls).
grammar.explanation_en: An adjective describes a noun. It comes after am/is/are (The elephant is big) or before a noun (a small bee). Adjectives have no plural: The mice are small.

grammar.title: Negative: am/is/are + not
grammar.explanation_ar: لنفي فعل be نضع not بعد am أو is أو are. ويمكن الاختصار: is not → isn't، are not → aren't. مع am نقول I'm not فقط.
grammar.explanation_en: To make be negative, put not after am, is or are. Short forms: is not → isn't, are not → aren't. With am, say I'm not.
examples: I am not short. → I'm not short.
She is not sad. → She isn't sad.
They are not teachers. → They aren't teachers.

grammar.title: Yes/No questions with be
grammar.explanation_ar: لنسأل بـ «هل» نضع am أو is أو are في أول الجملة قبل الفاعل، وننهيها بعلامة استفهام. Sami is your brother → Is Sami your brother?
grammar.explanation_en: To make a yes/no question, put am, is or are before the subject and end with a question mark. Sami is your brother. → Is Sami your brother?

grammar.title: Short answers
grammar.explanation_ar: نجيب بـ Yes أو No ثم فاصلة ثم ضمير + am/is/are (أو النفي). لا نستخدم الأسماء في الإجابة القصيرة بل الضمير: Is Hamza fit? Yes, he is. ولا نختصر في الإجابة بنعم: Yes, it is (وليس Yes, it's).
grammar.explanation_en: Answer with Yes or No, a comma, then pronoun + am/is/are (or the negative). Use a pronoun, not a name: Is Hamza fit? Yes, he is. Do not shorten the yes answer: Yes, it is (not Yes, it's).
examples: Is Ali a teacher? No, he isn't.
Are you a vet? Yes, I am.
Are these rulers? Yes, they are.
Are you teachers? No, we aren't.

questions.question: Make it negative: "She is happy."
questions.explanation_ar: نضع not بعد is: is not = isn't.

questions.question: Make it a question: "They are teachers."
"Is Hamza fit?" "Yes, ___."
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الضمير ولا نختصر في الإجابة بنعم: Yes, he is.
questions.explanation_en: Use the pronoun and the full form: Yes, he is.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: am not لا تُدمج؛ نقول I'm not.
questions.explanation_en: Am and not don't join; say I'm not.

questions.question: A road can be ...
questions.explanation_en: A road goes from one end to the other: long.

questions.question: What is the opposite of "new"?
questions.explanation_en: The opposite of new is old.

questions.question: Which sentence is written correctly?
questions.explanation_ar: حرف كبير في البداية وعلامة استفهام في النهاية.
questions.explanation_en: Capital letter at the start and a question mark at the end.

questions.question: "Are those camels?" "No, ___."
questions.explanation_ar: those جمع، فالضمير they والنفي aren't.
